# Little Smiles of Beverly Hills

> A pediatric dental practice in Beverly Hills specializing in gentle, minimally invasive treatments for children of all needs, led by Dr. Sepehr Nassiripour.

Little Smiles of Beverly Hills provides comprehensive children's dentistry services with a focus on holistic, anxiety-free care. The practice specializes in advanced techniques like ICON resin infiltration, silver diamine fluoride (SDF), and IV sedation dentistry for special needs and anxious children.
